nodes.description: Public mapping(bytes32 => uint256) holding each named account's ether balance; read and mutated by deposit and withdraw.
Public mapping(bytes32 => address) binding a named account to its controlling wallet address; written by approveAddress and read by withdraw.
Public mapping(address => bool) oracle whitelist used by the onlyOracles modifier; mutated by constructor, enableOracle and disableOracle.
Internal address of the contract owner; set in the constructor from msg.sender and compared against msg.sender in the onlyOwner modifier.
Access-control modifier requiring owner == msg.sender before allowing the wrapped function to execute.
Access-control modifier requiring _oracles[msg.sender] to be true before allowing the wrapped function to execute.
Constructor that sets owner = msg.sender and whitelists the owner as the first oracle.
Owner-only function that whitelists an arbitrary address as an oracle.
Owner-only function that removes an oracle from the whitelist, refusing to remove the owner.
Payable function crediting msg.value to a named account in _userBalances and emitting DepositEvent.
Function transferring the whole balance of a named account to the address bound in _usersByAddress; performs an external transfer before zeroing the balance.
Oracle-only function binding a wallet address to a named account in _usersByAddress.
Caller-controlled msg.sender compared with owner inside the onlyOwner modifier.
Caller-controlled msg.sender used as the lookup key into the _oracles whitelist in the onlyOracles modifier.
Deployer-controlled msg.sender assigned to owner and used to seed the oracle whitelist during construction.
Caller-controlled msg.sender emitted as the depositor address in DepositEvent.
Caller-controlled msg.sender compared with _usersByAddress[account] to authorise the withdrawal.
Unchecked arithmetic `_userBalances[account] += msg.value` inside deposit; susceptible to integer overflow/underflow.
External value transfer `payable(_usersByAddress[account]).transfer(_userBalances[account])` executed before the balance is cleared.
State write `_userBalances[account] = 0` performed after the external transfer, breaking the checks-effects-interactions order.
State write `_usersByAddress[account] = wallet` that grants custody of a named account solely on oracle status.
Address parameter supplied to enableOracle that becomes a whitelisted oracle.
Address parameter supplied to disableOracle that is removed from the oracle whitelist.
bytes32 account parameter of deposit used as the key credited with msg.value.
bytes32 account parameter of withdraw that selects the bound wallet and the balance to transfer.
Address parameter of approveAddress that is bound to the named account.
bytes32 account parameter of approveAddress used as the mapping key for the new wallet binding.

edges.reason: deposit uses the account parameter as the mapping key when crediting _userBalances.
The account parameter indexes the balance that is incremented in the unchecked `+=` operation.
The unchecked addition writes the new balance back into _userBalances and can wrap around on overflow.
The stored balance read from _userBalances is the value sent out by the external transfer inside withdraw.
The balance is cleared only after the external transfer, so the state write is reachable again during the call.
The recipient address for the external transfer is read from _usersByAddress inside withdraw.
The external value transfer hands control to the recipient address, which may invoke a fallback back into the contract.
withdraw resets the account balance in _userBalances to zero after the transfer.
withdraw uses the account parameter to look up the controlling wallet in _usersByAddress.
The account parameter governs which balance and recipient are used for the external transfer.
The account parameter selects which balance entry is zeroed by withdraw.
msg.sender drives the authorization require statement that decides whether withdraw continues.
msg.sender is compared against the wallet stored in _usersByAddress[account] to authorise the withdrawal.
The wallet parameter is stored into _usersByAddress, granting it control over the named account.
The account parameter selects the mapping slot in _usersByAddress that receives the new wallet.
The oracle-only write permanently rebinds _usersByAddress[account] to an arbitrary wallet.
approveAddress triggers the privileged state write that reassigns account ownership.
The onlyOracles modifier gates execution of approveAddress.
msg.sender determines the outcome of the onlyOracles whitelist check.
msg.sender is used as the lookup key into the _oracles whitelist.
msg.sender drives the owner check performed by the onlyOwner modifier.
msg.sender is compared against the stored owner variable to authorise privileged calls.
onlyOwner guards the oracle-whitelisting function enableOracle.
onlyOwner guards the oracle removal function disableOracle.
The constructor derives the privileged owner address directly from the deployer's msg.sender.
The oracle parameter supplied to enableOracle is written into the _oracles whitelist.
The oracle parameter supplied to disableOracle is used to clear its entry in the _oracles whitelist.
enableOracle mutates the oracle whitelist that governs future privileged operations.
disableOracle mutates the oracle whitelist, removing authorisation from an address.
deposit executes the unchecked balance increment on the credited account.
withdraw reaches the external value transfer before any state clearing occurs.
withdraw clears the balance after the external call, enabling a reentrant withdrawal path.
The depositor msg.sender is recorded in the DepositEvent emitted by deposit.
